temporal_classes.PREMATCH_READY: known_at is auditable and strictly earlier than prediction cutoff
temporal_classes.DERIVED_STRICT_PRIOR: computed only from events strictly earlier than target kickoff
temporal_classes.RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY: historical fact exists but original public availability time is not auditable
temporal_classes.BLOCKED: source or identity/timestamp quality insufficient for modeling

player_unavailable_suspension.temporal_class: BLOCKED until timestamped source is added

player_strength.temporal_class: DERIVED_STRICT_PRIOR for residual; expected_minutes/replacement quality need later validation

travel_load.temporal_class: BLOCKED until audited venue geocodes exist

manager_context.temporal_class: BLOCKED until timestamped manager source is added

tactical_shape.temporal_class: LIMITED: prior formation recognizable; richer tactics need source

weather_context.temporal_class: BLOCKED until timestamped forecast archive is added

hard_rules: never use target actual XI for a prediction made before official lineup publication
never use injury end_date/days_missed/games_missed to infer earlier availability
every external event must carry known_at before it can enter a formal prematch model
entity joins must be stable by competition/season and ambiguous mappings must remain auditable
unavailable fields remain null/BLOCKED; no synthetic backfill from post-match facts
